Class HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness
public class HistoricalScenarioCalibrationHarness extends Object
Historical Steady-Regime Calibration invalid input: '&' Multi-Resolution Sensitivity Harness.

Calibrates the core physical, demographic, and cliodynamic simulation engines against canonical historical epochs devoid of major systemic bifurcations/tipping points, enabling precise baseline parameter calibration before assessing non-linear disruptions.

Key Features:

  • Continuous Steady-Regime Epochs: Evaluates epochs with continuous historical trajectories (Classical Agrarian, High Medieval Growth, Pre-Industrial Early Modern, 2nd Industrial, Post-War Golden Age).
  • Before-After Dual-Domain Comparison:
    • Cartographic Tensor Domain: Compares $t_0 \to t_{\text{sim}}$ raster layers with empirical $t_1$ tensors using MapComparisonMetrics (RMSE, Pearson Cross-Correlation $r$, SSIM, Jaccard/Dice, KL Divergence).
    • Cliodynamic Telemetry Domain: Compares 27 socio-economic and biophysical variables against standardized empirical benchmarks (HYDE 3.2, Maddison, UN, FAO, CDIAC) computing $R^2$, RMSE, MAPE.
  • Drift Root Cause Decomposition invalid input: '&' Taxonomy: Distinguishes between stochastic historical shocks (exogenous) and systematic unidirectional engine drifts (Malthusian carrying capacity, demographic vital rates, innovation elasticity, exergy transition, spatial friction).
  • Automated Parameter Remediation ("Corriger"): Computes analytical parameter tuning recommendations and scaling multipliers.
  • Multi-Scale Spatial invalid input: '&' Temporal Discretization Matrix: Quantifies convergence, numerical stability, and computational ROI across H3 spatial resolutions (Res 2 to 5), demographic cohort sizes (10 to 1000), and temporal step sizes ($\Delta t \in [30\text{d}, 1825\text{d}]$).
